title: Depth and Autonomy: A Framework for Evaluating LLM Applications in Social Science Research
reasoning: The paper uses 'Letter 53' by Imam Ali (a foundational religious and legal text in Islam) as its primary case study for evaluating LLMs on their capacity for 'hermeneutic inference.' It explicitly tests the model's ability to extract and interpret theological and ethical concepts such as 'Supremacy of higher law (God's Book and Sunnah)' and 'God's covenant.'
